title: Indian Cricket Legends & Iconic Moments Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of the biggest moments, records, and legendary players in Indian Men's and Women's cricket.

questions.text: Who was the captain of the Indian Men's Cricket Team when they won their first-ever ICC Cricket World Cup in 1983?
Which legendary Indian batter holds the record for the most total runs scored in Women's ODI history?
Who hit six consecutive sixes in an over off Stuart Broad during the 2007 ICC World Twenty20?
Which Indian bowler is the all-time leading wicket-taker in Women's One Day International (ODI) cricket?
Under whose captaincy did India win the inaugural ICC T20 World Cup in 2007 and the ICC Cricket World Cup in 2011?
In the 2017 ICC Women's World Cup semi-final against Australia, which Indian batter played an iconic knock of 171* off 115 balls?
Who was the first Indian male player to hit a triple century (300 runs) in Test cricket?
Who became the first cricketer in world history to score 100 international centuries across Test and ODI formats?
Which Indian female opener scored a double century (205*) against England in a Test match in 2002 at the age of 19?
Against which country did Rohit Sharma score his famous high-score of 264 in ODI cricket in 2014?
Against which nation did India score their legendary Kolkata Test win in 2001 after being forced to follow-on?
Which fast bowler became the first Indian female bowler to take 200 ODI wickets?
Which Indian bowler achieved a famous Test hat-trick against Pakistan in the very first over of the match in 2006?
Which Indian player became the fastest batter to score 50 ODI centuries, breaking Sachin Tendulkar's record during the 2023 World Cup?
Who holds the record for the highest individual score by an Indian woman in T20 Internationals (124 runs)?
Who was the star Player of the Match in the 1983 World Cup Final for his all-round performance (26 runs & 3/12)?
Which Indian off-spinner took all 10 wickets in a single Test innings against Pakistan at Feroz Shah Kotla in 1999?
Who became the youngest player—male or female—to play in the final of a World Cup in 2020 at the age of 16?
In 1971, India won their first-ever Test series in both the West Indies and England under whose captaincy?
Who was named the Player of the Tournament in the 2011 ICC Men's Cricket World Cup for his match-winning all-round efforts?
